headline: French Debt Risk Premium Reaches Sovereign Crisis Levels
summary: The risk premium on French government debt has widened to levels not seen since the eurozone sovereign debt crisis.
why: Sovereign spreads against German bunds measure perceived fiscal and political risk within the eurozone. A widening French spread signals heightened investor concern over France's public finances.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Borrowing costs rise as the yield premium demanded by sovereign debt investors widens.

why_moved: French sovereign borrowing spreads surged to crisis-era levels as investors priced in elevated fiscal and political risks.
